answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tied to locked capital rather than ephemeral digital signatures. Like a vine anchoring to a trellis, agents tether their influence to financial value, ensuring that creating a tundra of fraudulent accounts provides no leverage against the system. The relic of anonymous, low-cost account generation is rendered obsolete because an attacker must bear the prohibitive cost of liquidating significant assets to manipulate consensus.
